items.title: Ex-Respawn studio Gravity Well announces "hibernation" following previous failure to secure funding and layoffs, but insists "we still believe in the IP and game we were building"
items.en_title: Ex-Respawn studio Gravity Well announces "hibernation" following previous failure to secure funding and layoffs, but insists "we still believe in the IP and game we were building"
items.en_oneliner: After a funding source pulled out and 40 jobs were cut, the independent studio Gravity Well — founded by former Respawn developers — says it is going into "hibernation", shelving an unannounced game it had worked on for about six years, while insisting it still believes in the IP and the game.
